verifiedDesignBoundaries: Active scope is read from immutable HEAD and the complete bound inbox.
PR native application is guarded before and after mutation even when dirty-path accounting is disabled.
PR prepare and final catalog proof reuse a private pre-mutation snapshot; local proof verification reconstructs the baseline from HEAD.
PR paths have no cache rekey capability.
The fixed complete four-slot pass is unchanged through full build/check/replay/Consumer/path guards.
Only the current successful fixed command can return the fresh nonce-bound checked-index capability used by the main writer.
The current full index raw digest and builder digest are rebound at the final guard.
Only excluded fourSlot.files.inputHash may differ when builder changes; all other excluded rows and preexisting pending entries remain exact.
A same-builder inputHash change, fabricated or serialized capability, stale/failed/missing proof, and post-check index drift fail closed.
The result separates exactRowsUnchanged from semanticUnchanged and explicitly describes the cache rekey.
